name: GLOBAL_EQUATION_MASK
description: Replaces a list of pairwise inequality constraints with a single global summation equation over all pairs. The equation is designed such that each term is non-negative and is zero if and only if the inequality holds. This forces models to algebraically deduce that the global sum being zero implies every individual pairwise inequality must hold in order to prune the search space; naive translation results in a global check that causes Time Limit Exceeded.
